hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. Constrained intermediaries demand compensation for monetary-policy uncertainty, so long high-beta foreign currency vs USD earns a premium on scheduled FOMC statement days (Mueller, Tahbaz-Salehi & Vedolin, JF 2017: AUD +17.3 bp vs +1.2 bp on other days, 1994-2013). Sign fixed: long AUD.
rules: Event set: cal_fomc rows with scheduled=True (statement days, New York date). ENTRY at the open of the 18:05 America/New_York 1m bar on the evening before the statement day (after the 18:00 ET Globex reopen, inside the futures trading day of the statement); EXIT at the open of the 15:58 America/New_York 1m bar of the statement day. Position: LONG 6A front-month futures (HistData AUDUSD spot 1m as the price proxy) (long the high-beta foreign currency vs USD), fixed sign, every scheduled statement day, no conditioning on the expected decision. No order is placed between 13:58 and 14:02 New York (statement at 14:00); the position is held through it. Missing entry/exit bar -> event skipped (no forward fill). Unscheduled meetings excluded. Per-event P&L = return x weight.
parameters: entry 18:05 New York day -1; exit 15:58 New York day 0; instrument 6A; no surprise conditioning
instruments: CME 6A / M6A (HistData AUDUSD 1m spot as price proxy)
holding: about 22 hours inside one futures trading day (18:05 ET -> 15:58 ET); 8 events/yr
vol_scaler: weight = (0.10/sqrt(252)) / sigma, sigma = EWMA (com 60 days) s.d. of daily 17:00 New York close-to-close AUDUSD log returns through the close before entry; no cap/floor.
cost_model: 1x floors: 1 tick (0.00005, about 0.75 bp) + $2.50 per side per 6A contract (about 0.4 bp) applied at entry and exit on the bid-to-bid spot return; overnight-session thinness at 18:05 ET covered by the 2x run, which is attached.
decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos'): pass iff (1) one-sided t of the net-1x per-event P&L (day-clustered; stationary/day-cluster bootstrap >= 430,000 draws) >= 3.6807; (2) net-2x mean > 0 (criterion 3); (3) criteria 4 and 7 of PARAMETERS.md (years, concentration, terciles, +-25% neighbours on entry/exit times or thresholds, one-bar delay) pass; (4) Red Team and re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Anything else is 'refuted' or 'near-miss' (near-miss = t >= 2.0 with criterion 3 passed); the result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length.
notes: VENUE TWIN of Q-0003 (same hypothesis, futures costs and Globex clock; the Referee reads the pair as one hypothesis with two cost models). Economics: 8 bp after haircut vs 6A round trip about 2.3 bp = 3.5x. EVIDENCE WINDOW: G10 spot vs USD on FOMC days 1994-2013 (MTV JF 2017, fetched 2026-11-03 per candidates.md); 2014-2024 untouched -> not derivative. Realistic: about 8 bp after haircut vs about 70 bp s.d. per 22 h, 8 events/yr -> annual Sharpe about 0.3, power under 0.05: a stack-sleeve test, not an account strategy. Economics: 8 bp after haircut vs 3 bp CFD round trip = 2.7x (just under the 3x needed for the 2x-cost criterion; disclosed). Red Team strongest objection: the MTV premium is a 1994-2013 ZLB-era/risk-on artefact and the AUD was the carry currency then; post-2014 AUD-USD rate differential shrank and turned negative 2019-2023 - answerable only by the test; sign is fixed so it cannot be rescued by flipping.
